points.description: Synapses / connecting links, each characterized by a weight (applied to the inputs).
points.partial_credit: Mentions inputs or connections but not weights.

points.description: Adder / linear combiner computes the weighted sum of the inputs (local field) plus a bias.
points.partial_credit: Weighted sum given but bias missing, or adder named without saying what it computes.

points.description: Activation (squashing) function limits the amplitude of the neuron's output.
points.partial_credit: Names an activation function but does not say it limits/squashes the output.

rubric.notes: Full marks need all three components: weighted synapses, an adder (linear combiner) giving the weighted sum plus bias, and an activation (squashing) function limiting output amplitude. Give part marks when a component is vague or one element (e.g. bias) is missing. Give no marks for a biological description of a neuron or wrong components. Different wording is fine if the technical terms are used.
